correctness.rationale: For any coordinate set E the row/column parity-check kernel has dimension e−v+c by oriented bipartite incidence, including characteristic two. Every edge in a supported subcode belongs to a cycle; each nonempty component then has e_i≥4. Its cycle rank is at most (sqrt(e_i)−1)² by e_i≤a_i b_i and a_i+b_i≥2 sqrt(e_i), with equality only for K_{t,t}. Strict superadditivity of f(e)=(sqrt(e)−1)² on e≥4 prohibits a multi-component equality. At dimension s² and e=(s+1)² all bounds are equalities, forcing a single full (s+1)² rectangle and its entire s²-dimensional flow space. Counting rectangles and minimal erasure events follows. Independently recomputed all relevant square-rank optimum graph supports for 2×4,3×3,3×4,4×4, obtaining (6),(9,1),(18,4),(36,16,1). Finite tests do not prove the arbitrary-field statement.
